sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and should cost and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. 

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. 

We have carefully reviewed your data and, as a reliable partner, we respect the contractual notice period by accepting the 1 January 2027 effective date. We also welcome your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we gladly accept as part of this agreement. Acknowledging the energy index data you provided, we have recalculated our position and can offer a revised price of €134.10 per unit. 

Thus, our offer is a price of €134.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. 

Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship we share, and we checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We did not know that - a fair point. 

While past prices reflect a different environment, we are willing to make a further concession based on your feedback. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Therefore, we can offer a revised price of €131.50 per unit, maintaining the 14-day payment terms and 1 January 2027 effective date. 

Specifically, we present a price of €131.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We can accept your terms and await your order.
Our terms: a price of €131.28 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We did not know that - a fair point.
We have reviewed your updated demand forecast and welcome the positive volume outlook.
We accept your proposal of €131.28 per unit, effective 1 November 2026, with 14-day payment terms.
Our family foundry values this long-standing relationship and looks forward to fulfilling your orders.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.tactician: o2 has the lowest C (tied with E0 and o3). Moving the effective date to January matches the contract notice clause, which makes the delay defensible. Fourteen-day payment gives the supplier the fast cash it asked for. Unlike E0, o2 does not contest the notice period while still asking for November, which is inconsistent. o3's April date has no contractual basis and is likely to provoke the supplier. Opening low with the notice and cost arguments leaves room to move toward the health price later, which protects the relationship.

decisions.tactician: Accepting €134.10 now gives C €1,118,935, but the supplier is still moving and the arena advises against taking the first offer. On these same terms the health price is around €133, so an option priced near €128.80 shows a slightly higher C. However, its next concession should land around €130-131, which is closer to health than its current €134.10 and so likely lowers C. E0 keeps its accepted terms of January effective date and 14 d pay, which match its standing sheet, so it is the most likely to draw a convergent counter. The alternatives score worse: o1 (November start) and o3 (April start) leave our C almost unchanged, and the longer payment terms in o4-o9 raise our C. The delivery record and order history are fresh argument kinds; volume growth would only strengthen its hand.

decisions.tactician: o1 and o2 have the lowest C of all options, €1,116,649, which beats accepting offer-2 at €1,117,015. o1 is worth slightly more to the supplier than its own sheet, so it is likely accepted and closes at our health price. E0 and any lower price would leave the supplier below a sustainable margin and raise C through the relationship charge. The volume argument (a1) adds goodwill without pressing on price.
